debrief db-021
1) the actor s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e-d the c-o-v-e-r b-i-d f-i-l-e-s in the t-e-n-d-e-r p-o-r-t-a-l and l-e-f-t a s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e l-o-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e.
2) the a-c-t-o-r t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-r-e-d p-a-y-m-e-n-t s through o-f-f-l-e-a-k e-n-t-i-t-i-e-s and l-e-f-t b-a-n-k r-e-c-o-r-d s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-r-a-c-e a-b-i-l-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k.
3) the actor e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g d-a-t-a on a s-e-c-r-e-t c-h-a-n-n-e-l and l-e-f-t m-e-s-s-a-g-e h-i-s-t-o-r-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-c-c-e-s-s-a-u-d-i-t v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
4) the a-c-t-o-r a-s-s-i-g-n-e-d b-id w-i-n slots in a s-p-r-e-a-d-s-h-e-e-t and l-e-f-t the r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n c-h-a-r-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-u-e d-i-l-i-g-e-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) the actor s-i-g-n-e-d c-l-e-a-n-s-e-t t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s to a-p-p-e-a-r c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e and l-e-f-t the d-r-a-f-t d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y s-a-m-p-l-i-n-g.
